summary_en: Kiran, a working professional, called to ask about Python and SQL/PowerBI courses, including duration, fees, eligibility, evening or weekend batches, installment options, placement support, prerequisites, live projects, and a possible demo or discussion. The agent explained that only the Python with Data Analytics course is currently offered; it lasts 8 weeks, costs ₹8,999 total, is open to graduates and final-year students, and does not require prior coding. Available batches are weekday evenings from 8:00–9:00 PM and weekends from 10:00 AM–1:00 PM. Installments are not available. The course includes 100% placement assistance through resume building, interview preparation, and job referrals, but there is no strict job or salary guarantee. The agent could not confirm that the enquiry, demo request, or live-project question could be forwarded to the team, and initially stated that no follow-up could be guaranteed. Kiran provided his name, email, and phone number and requested that the enquiry be noted and a callback be considered. The call ended with the agent stating that the details and callback request had been recorded and thanking him.
next_action: Review the recorded enquiry and contact Kiran at 9876543210 regarding the requested demo or discussion, live-project details, prerequisites, and any further course information.
